caseNameFull: Indianapolis v. Chase National Bank, Trustee
attorneys: Messrs. Floyd J. Mattice, William H. Thompson, and Albert L. Rabb for petitioners., Messrs. Howard F. Burns and William L. Taylor for respondents.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Butler took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
